name: mr-review
description: One command that reviews the checked-out merge request branch against its target: merge conflicts, pre-checks for secrets and risky patterns, and Claude's findings in a live pane.

targetBranch.title: Target branch
targetBranch.description: The branch the merge request targets when /mr-review is run without one.

remote.title: Remote
remote.description: The remote the target branch is fetched from before comparing.

fetch.title: Fetch before review
fetch.description: Run git fetch for the target branch so the conflict check uses the remote's state.
